display_text: Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver) ** Adds [[Force Burst#Force Burst|Force Burst]][[Force Burst#Force Burst|Force Burst]]: This weapon is humming with magical force, and does 1 to 6 force damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 force damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.[[Category:Force Burst items]][[Category:Upgradeable items]]
raw_html: [[Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver)]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]][[Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver)]]: This item could be upgraded if you found a [[Item:Seal of the Stormreaver|Seal of the Stormreaver]] to combine it with. Bring this item to the [[Stormreaver Monument]] in [[Gianthold]] and combine it with a Seal of the Stormreaver to upgrade the item to a more powerful form. ** Adds [[Force Burst#Force Burst|Force Burst]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Force Burst#Force Burst|Force Burst]]:''' This weapon is humming with magical force, and does 1 to 6 force damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 force damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.[[Category:Force Burst items]][[Category:Upgradeable items]]
